title: Python and GitHub Actions style guides live in .claude/skills and are linked from .github/instructions
answers: where are the Python style conventions documented
where is the GitHub Actions workflow style guide
which file does Copilot review use for Python or workflow conventions
where do I edit the python-style or github-actions-style guidance
body:
Python conventions are in .claude/skills/python-style/SKILL.md and workflow/composite-action conventions are in .claude/skills/github-actions-style/SKILL.md (each has name and description frontmatter).
.github/instructions/python.instructions.md (applyTo: "**/*.py") and .github/instructions/github-actions.instructions.md (applyTo: .github/workflows and .github/actions yml) are Copilot review entry points that link to these skill files.
.agents/skills is a symlink to ../.claude/skills, so the same skill files are shared between Claude and agents tooling.
The older .claude/rules/python.md and .claude/rules/github-actions.md paths no longer exist after this change.
applies: Anyone looking for or editing Python or GitHub Actions style guidance in this repository.
says: Where can I find the official style guidelines for Python code and CI workflows?
Automated code review assistants are not referencing the latest guidelines for workflows and code.
Update coding conventions so that AI reviewers and developer assistants share identical style guides.
Old documentation files for coding standards and automation guidelines are missing or moved.
